messages:
devx-maria: Starting a small refresh of the starter quickstart focused on auth and first deploy. Plan: replace long-lived key example with ephemeral flow, update SDK v5 snippets, fix broken links.

amy: Sounds good. Ping me when PR is up and I'll look at the snippets.

devx-maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starterkit/pull/319 — docs-only. Changed files: quickstart.md, docs/auth.md, examples/ephemeral.md

ben: Are we recommending server-side token exchange or client ephemeral direct call? we should standardize.

chris: Strongly recommend server-side exchange to avoid shipping long-lived keys in browser examples.

devx-maria: Current example uses minimal server exchange. Snippet:
```
// server /api/ephemeral
const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.dev/ephemeral', {method:'POST', headers:{Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`}})
const { ephemeral_key } = await r.json()
// client
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: ephemeral_key })
```

sam: Security note: recommend ephemeral TTL 10m for interactive demos. ops prefers 10m, examples may show 5m for brevity; added guidance to auth.md.

devx-maria: Updated docs, added migration sidebar: SDK v4 -> v5 renames and small code differences. @amy can you sanity-check SDK phrasing?

amy: I'll review tomorrow. Left one inline wording suggestion about "initialize" vs "instantiate".

doc-bot: PR 319 lint: 0 errors, 2 warnings (style). Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.dev/starterkit/319

deploy-bot: preview ready: https://deploy-preview-319--starterkit.netlify.app/quickstart

chris: Please add a one-line "what changed" at top so existing users notice auth update.

devx-maria: Added changelog blurb and code comment reminding to keep long-lived key in env var. Target merge tomorrow EOD unless blocking.

ben: Reviewing migration notes now; will finish today. :thumbsup:
